findings.description: delete_entry calls _require_reader, so any user the entry is shared with can permanently delete the owner's journal entry. Every other destructive or mutating handler (edit, share, unshare) uses _require_owner. Deletion by a mere reader causes data loss for the owner.
findings.suggestion: Use _require_owner(entry, user) in delete_entry. Readers should use leave_entry instead.
findings.title: delete_entry authorizes with reader check instead of owner check
